Between the lines, add brief narration: small physical actions, glances, and sensory details of the place described in the plan. Youssef blinked, the pen stilling. “So what do you substitute for gum, then?”

Brigitte set the cap on the bench with a soft click. “Queens lay fifteen-hundred eggs daily during peak season if workers feed royal jelly.”

Youssef exhaled, a long, weary sound that fogged slightly in the cool draft from the corridor. “Great, glad the bees are busy. Which compound gives the cleanest fold?”

She picked up her bag, slinging the strap over her shoulder without breaking eye contact. “A single colony can fly the equivalent of eight round-trips to the moon gathering nectar.”

Youssef closed his notebook, the leather cover snapping shut with finality. “Forget I asked. I’ll figure it out myself.”
